description:
# 1.47.0-mod.4 (2026-10-22)

* Fix the Restore learning reminders startup crash on Duolingo 6.102.4: preserve the live User before its register is reused.
* Verify the fix with Android ART on a connected device and retain the complete Hoodles 1.47.0 catalog, Modded display name, and upstream sync configuration.

Update this remote source, then patch an original Duolingo 6.102.4 APK again and install the resulting app.
